 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Mithilesh Kumar, Advocate

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
 Oral Order
8 17-04-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the respondents.

The petitioner has filed the instant application for the following relief(s):
"That this is an application for issuance of an appropriate writ/writs, order(s) or direction(s) to the respondents to release and make the payments of the rest of the amounts i.e Rs. 32,88,000/- with 15% per annum interest till the date of payment to the petitioner since the raiyati land of the petitioner appertaining to the Khata no. 94 Khesara no. 76 Area 16 Katha situated under Mauza Mahmadpur Patna High Court CWJC No.3859 of 2018(8) dt.17-04-2023 Gautam Thana no. 514 of district Begusarai has already been acquired by the respondents in the year 2013 under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act 1894."
Pramila Devi vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102358810/
1

entities.text: Pramila Devi vs The State Of Bihar And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during pendency of the instant application the petitioner has been paid the balance consideration amount, however, the petitioner disputes the amount paid by way of interest.
Learned counsel submits that in effect the petitioner has objection to the amount of compensation paid as a result of the acquisition.

After some argument, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application to move before the appropriate authority under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The application is disposed of as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.

In case the application is filed within a period of four weeks from today, the authority concerned shall decide the same in accordance with law at the earliest preferably within a period of six months from the date of its filing.

(Partha Sarthy, J) Saurabh/-
